notes.title: Patch Note V0.4.2.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2] 

[list] 
[*] Added a cooldown to avoid sorcerer to spam grab/release animation with downed villagers 
[*] Added new progress bar to Exit Doors 
[*] Added missing mouse sensitivity settings 
[*] Change the interaction system with the Holy Book and the Book Protection Totems to convert them to the same system as other interactions in the game 
[*] Added first version of a Tutorial in Main Menu accessible with “How to Play” button 
[/list] 

[h2]Fixes[/h2] 

[list] 
[*] Multiple destroyed Ritual Totems were counted if multiple players destroyed the same totem 
[*] Progress Bar wasn’t disappearing in some cases when Ritual Totems were destroyed 
[*] Prevent script of the Exit Doors from not replicating correctly in some cases 
[*] Prevent villagers to be stuck in final Banish Animation early by adding some additional verification 
[*] Visual glitches on some VFX have been located and removed 
[/list] 

[h2]Known issues[/h2] 

[list] 
[*] In some cases, players joining a lobby may experience display issues with their XP level, profile picture, and favorite character shown in the lobby. Fix coming soon. 
[/list] 

[h3]Update size : 44.4 MB[/h3]

notes.title: Patch Note V0.4.1.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added new progress bar for Rituals Totems and for Memorials of the Damned
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] A bug that could create a duplicate of a player character upon players appearance at the beginning of a game
[*] The possibility for the sorcerer to smash while the player was stunned or in the final banish ritual
[*] Villagers were never considered to have exited the interaction zone of the exit door
[*] More than one villagers could trigger the exiting door unlock or prayers on Memorials of the Damned at the same time in some cases
[*] Incorrect Rituals Totems count was considered for accomplish the Escape quest of the villagers
[*] Rituals Totems was stopping from being destroyed when a villager leaved the interaction while one or more villagers was still trying to destroying it in some cases
[*] For some players, the magic circle indicating that they were trying to destroy Ritual Totems wasn’t appearing correctly
[*] Fix FSR Quality Modes not displaying when graphic card not compatible with DLSS
[*] Stamina wasn’t decreasing for some players resulting in infinite sprint capability [i](might still occur, please let us know if you observe it.)[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Update size : 30.9 MB[/h3]
